title: 怎样活得像一个数学家
content: The article critiques how society reduces complex individuals to simplistic stereotypes. Using mathematician Wei Dongyi—famous for holding buns and a water bottle—as a case study, it shows how public imagination transformed him into a "sweeping monk" archetype, where perceived life incompetence became proof of mathematical genius. When Wei's verified Bilibili account quietly posted math tutorials and listed exercise books (priced ¥39.8 and ¥49.8), some viewers treated this normal professional activity as betraying his ascetic image. The author contrasts two recent Fields Medal winners—one fashionably dressed, the other minimalist—to demonstrate mathematicians need not conform to any lifestyle template. The core argument: professions are not roles requiring specific props; true authenticity means living without using spectators as scriptwriters, whether imposing stereotypes on others or performing them oneself.

title: 越会用 AI 的人，学习能力退化得越快
content: A study of 26,811 Chinese middle and high school students over 30 months found that AI use improved homework scores by 18% and reduced completion time by 30%, but caused a 20% drop in closed-book exam performance. The negative effect, termed "generative AI learning penalty," worsened over time as students increasingly outsourced rather than used AI as a tutor. Similar patterns appeared in doctors, writers, and programmers: AI improved immediate output but degraded underlying skills when removed. The penalty is narrowing but not disappearing, raising concerns about diminishing critical thinking and independent problem-solving abilities across age groups.

title: OpenAI 全面开源 Codex Harness
content: OpenAI open-sourced Codex Harness, the underlying framework for AI agents. The release includes CLI tool codex exec, official SDK, and app-server for zero-barrier integration. Harness lets developers embed agent loops directly into products rather than using generic chat interfaces, improving model performance while reducing API costs. The framework supports applications beyond coding, including tax filing, cloud management, and logistics dashboards. Developers gain full control over interfaces, context, tools, operations, and security, enabling native AI applications.
